name: Kaal Sarp Dosh Shanti Puja
purpose: To nullify the negative effects of Kaal Sarp Yog in the birth chart.
benefits: Removes obstacles in marriage, career growth, and health issues.

name: Mangal Dosh Bhai Dooj Puja
purpose: To cancel the negative effects of Mars in 1st, 4th, 7th, 8th, or 12th house before marriage.
benefits: Ensures marital harmony, prevents spouse's death or illness.
